title: Union Church, Hong Kong
geometryBasis: Combines the archived 2017 place of worship polygon, the published address and the original 2007 site photographs. The distinct named present facility verifies the persistent site identity.
sectionBasis: The original Hong Kong 5 m elevation grid determines the Kennedy Road retaining grade. The old sanctuary and freestanding tower are proportioned from the 2007 reference and the official architectural description.
limitations: The old lot is recorded by the native 2017 map. The exact sanctuary, tower dimensions, step details and rear elevations are estimated from the original 2007 photography and the official building description.
The modeled church is the demolished sanctuary. The 2023 replacement remains separate from the dated model.
